BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Reilly are pleased to present an instantly appealing three bedroom extended mid terrace home located in a mature village setting adjacent to a host of quality local amenities and services. This lovely home should be of interest to first time buyers and investors offers great value in a delightful convenient setting. 

It boasts an entrance hall, lounge, kitchen, TV room, three bedrooms and a bathroom room which combined with many attractive finishes / features adding to its appeal. It is conveniently located in a delightful village where an array of excellent amenities are readily available including shops, primary school, church and a variety of sports and recreational facilities. Commuting to Dublin city and its surrounding areas is very convenient via a frequent daily bus service and easy access to the M4 and M7 motorways. Viewing is recommended by prior appointment.
